What to look for when buying a used truck or SUV

Ask to let an independent mechanic look at it. If you're buying off a lot and they just-so-happen to have a garage right next door, don't take their word for shit.

If they sperg and wimper, walk away from that money pit.
It should ideally have a minimum of three working wheels. It should get atleast three hectares to the hogshead. It should have an engine. The front shouldn't fall off.

Besides letting a mechanic looking at it, to save yourself the time...

Check all the fluids and make sure they are clean and topped off. Check for leaks. Check for rust, especially on the frame, engine mounts, etc. Check to see if the heat and the electrical stuff works. These can be expensive to fix and are often overlooked. Replacing the heater core is a pain in the ass. It's a cheap part but in most models you have to take the dash board off and it can cost you about 8 hours of labor. Electrical problems can be hard to diagnose and can run up repair bills.

I probably wouldn't buy a truck with a rebuilt engine. Mileage is important but you should check to ensure that it was maintained properly. A higher mileage engine could be in better shape than a low mileage engine that hasn't been taken care of.
